**KenShell 0.1.0** is the first release of KenShell, a lightweight network terminal for
network engineers: SSH, Telnet and serial console in one small, fast app, with a CLI
analyzer that understands switches, routers and firewalls.

## Download

| System | Download |
| --- | --- |

| **Windows** (MSI, for IT deployment) | [KenShell-Windows.msi](https://github.com/omereniskorkusuz/kenshell/releases/download/v0.1.0/KenShell-Windows.msi) |

Click a file to download it; the same files are under **Assets** below.

> **First launch:** these builds are not code-signed yet.
> **macOS:** System Settings → Privacy & Security → **Open Anyway** (once).
> **Windows:** SmartScreen → **More info → Run anyway**.

## Highlights

- **USB console, plug and connect:** detects the cable and its chip, sets the baud rate
  automatically, and tells you when a driver is missing.
- **Always know where you are:** the device's identity, a colour stripe for the CLI mode
  (user / privileged / config) and PROD / LAB / TEST tags on every session.
- **SSH, Telnet, serial, Rlogin and raw TCP:** includes port forwarding, jump host, proxy,
  X11 forwarding, the SSH agent and legacy algorithms.
- **Analyzer:** `show` output turns into tables. It also includes read-only diagnostics,
  config audit, config backups with diff, `show tech` and log analysis, CDP/LLDP topology,
  and multi-device commands.
- **Notes:** a notes bar under every session for time-stamped notes, plus device and
  interface notes.
- **Tools:**
  - **File transfer:** an SFTP/SCP client, and built-in TFTP, FTP and SCP servers.
  - **Network:** a network scanner, subnet calculator, OUI/MAC lookup, ping and traceroute.
  - **Recording:** session recording and replay, and export as TXT or coloured HTML.
- **Small and fast:** starts in ~0.3 s and uses ~85 MB of memory when idle.
- **Private:** no telemetry. Passwords stay in the OS keychain and never reach logs or exports.

## Coming next

- **AI assistant:** explains device output and errors and suggests commands, using your
  own Anthropic API key. It is built and will be switched on in an upcoming release.

See the [User Guide](https://github.com/omereniskorkusuz/kenshell/blob/main/docs/USER_GUIDE.md)
for how to use everything.
